notes: PT-VMZ71U7 is the North American (NTSC-region) SKU of the PT-VMZ71 series 3LCD laser projector, bundled with a standard zoom lens. Terminal panel and specs confirmed from Panasonic's official Spec File (VMZ71G_STR_01, dated Jan 2022, docs.connect.panasonic.com) which documents the PT-VMZ71 core model; the U7 regional variant shares identical electronics/terminal panel (differs only in included lens/power cord region and cosmetic color per Panasonic's documentation conventions). Power inlet is labeled "AC IN ~" on the rear panel next to SERIAL IN; it takes a detachable IEC power cord (2 supplied for Europe/Asia models, 1 for other regions), consistent with a standard IEC C13/C14-style inlet — exact IEC pin/current rating (C13 vs C19) not explicitly printed in the spec sheet, so classified as "iec" (C13/C14 class) based on the 420W/100-240V rating, which is well within C13 range. There are two separate RJ-45 ports: one labeled simply "LAN" (network control only, 10Base-T/100Base-TX) and one labeled "LAN/DIGITAL LINK" (HDBaseT-compliant, carries video signal + network + RS-232 control, supports HDCP 1.4/Deep Color/4K@30p). Both are graded eth-100m per their stated 10/100Base-TX spec (no gigabit support stated). HDMI inputs support 4K/30p and HDCP 1.4/Deep Color — graded hdmi-1.4 (does not meet HDMI 2.0 bandwidth/features). USB port is Type-A, used for Memory Viewer/optional wireless module/5V-2A DC power-out — functions as a host port (bidirectional data + power out), but spec sheet gives no USB signaling speed (likely USB 2.0 class); grade omitted since no explicit spec was stated (could reasonably be inferred as usb-2.0 for a Type-A projector viewer port, but left blank per "omit whenever the spec does not state a version/speed"). Desktop/ceiling-mount unit, no rack ears — rackUnits omitted. Weight 7.0 kg (15.4 lb).
